index.title: Document types
index.hint: Central catalog of document types for license application requirements. Leagues pick from this catalog which documents a license application requires.
index.requestHint: New document types can be requested at sbk@floorball.de.
index.name: Name
index.requiredBelowAgeHint: Only required if the player is younger at the time of application (e.g. 18). Empty = always required.
index.templateRemoveMarked: Template will be removed on save.
index.deleteInUseHint: This document type is already in use (uploads or league configuration) and cannot be deleted.
index.infoLinksHint: Addresses of information sheets on floorball.de that the Saisonmanager links to in fixed places. If a file is moved there, change the address here.
index.infoLinksEmpty: No address stored – the link is not shown.
index.infoLinksUrlHint: Full address including https://. Leave empty to hide the link.
